none: PAS NLM-50DB62: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Probably a copy nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), probably a Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust right. Reverse description: Two soldiers, possibly with one standard between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 13.8mm, Weight: 1.00gms, die axis: possibly 6
